description_en: Retrieves connection credentials for a cloud application
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center get-connection-ticket --product-type CloudApp --end-user-id alice --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --task-id 28778acb-a469-4bc0-8e0f0000 --app-id ca-e4s0puhmwi7v0000 --app-version 1.0.0 --app-start-param /q_/n --environment-config example-string --app-instance-group-id-list aig-4xz0oy8x4ipyv0000 --app-instance-persistent-id p-0bxls9m3cl7s0000 --app-instance-id ai-1rznfnrvsa99d0000 --access-type INTERNET --app-policy-id example-string --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetConnectionTicket

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

> If you specify this parameter, application instances are allocated only from delivery groups in the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

> 当传入本参数时，仅会在参数指定地域的交付组中分配应用实例
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The task ID.

> This parameter is required for non-initial calls. Use this parameter to query the task status and connection credentials
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。

> 非首次调用时必填。使用本参数查询任务状态和连接凭证
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en:
The application ID.

> This parameter is required for the initial call and optional for subsequent calls
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID。

> 首次调用时必填，后续调用时选填
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The application version. If you specify this parameter, only the specified version of the application is opened. If you do not specify this parameter, any authorized version of the application is opened
parameters.help_zh: 应用版本。传入本参数时，仅会打开参数所指定版本的应用。如果不传入本参数，则会打开已授权的任意版本的应用
parameters.name: app_version

parameters.help_en: The application startup parameter. For information about how to obtain startup parameters, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426045.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用启动参数。关于启动参数的获取方法，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426045.html
parameters.name: app_start_param

parameters.help_en:
The list of delivery groups.

> - If you specify this parameter, application instances are allocated only from the specified authorized delivery groups.
> - If you specify the `AppInstanceId` or `AppInstancePersistentId` parameter, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
交付组列表。

> - 当传入本参数时，仅会在参数指定的且已授权的交付组中分配应用实例。
> - 当传入`AppInstanceId`或`AppInstancePersistentId `参数时，本参数必填
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id_list

parameters.help_en:
The application instance ID.

> 
> - If you specify this parameter, only the specified application instance is allocated.
> - If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the `AppInstanceGroupIdList` parameter, and the number of delivery group IDs in `AppInstanceGroupIdList` must be 1
parameters.help_zh:
应用实例ID。

> 
> - 当传入本参数时，仅会尝试分配参数所指定的应用实例。
> - 当传入本参数时，必须同时传入`AppInstanceGroupIdList`参数，且`AppInstanceGroupIdList`中交付组ID的数量为1
parameters.name: app_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The access type. If you do not specify this parameter, both types are displayed.

Valid values:
- INTERNET: Internet access.
- VPC: Express Connect access
parameters.help_zh:
接入类型，不传表示两种都显示。
取值范围：
互联网：INTERNET
专线：VPC
